acquisition_semantics: Request-time hashes describe each historical response. Acquisition-1 zero-byte target files were replaced by successful acquisition-2. Current retained hashes are in files. HTTP error bodies with pdf suffix are not PDFs.

dedup.scope: Hidden/ignored inclusive; symlinks followed. Repository data/research/reviews/history and cited local cmm roots only; text8MB bound; unextracted binary semantics excluded. Not a machinewide or literature-exhaustive absence claim. Non-directory first components are excluded without claiming every one is missing.

excluded_non_directory_reference_tokens.note: The initial regex captured first path components that also included named files, serialized fragments and missing directories. These tokens are NOT a list of missing raw roots; no absence inference is drawn from them.

remaining_gates: Independent scientific review and coordinator final batch/history/review gates pending at source report capture.
